seeds.scene: A pool deck with 8 people; posted rules: 'no glass containers', 'no running', 'children under 12 require adult'. Visible: 1 person with a glass bottle, 2 children running unaccompanied, 1 adult walking with a metal bottle, others within rules.
seeds.question: How many people violate at least one rule?
seeds.lever: Apply each rule to each person and count distinct violators (children running counts both as running and unaccompanied but is one person).

seeds.scene: A pegboard with hooks containing tools. A printed inventory list at the side names 12 tools that should be present; 11 tools are visible on the board.
seeds.question: Which tool is MISSING from the wall?
seeds.answer: the named tool not visible on the wall
seeds.lever: Cross-reference inventory list with visible items to identify the absent one.

seeds.scene: A line drawing of a Penrose triangle on a gallery wall.
seeds.question: Is this object physically constructible in 3D?
seeds.lever: Recognize impossible-figure family and rule out 3D realizability.

seeds.scene: An elevator inspection certificate posted in the cab; expiry date '2024-03-15'. Today's date stamped overlay: '2026-04-01'.
seeds.question: Is this elevator's inspection currently valid?
seeds.lever: Compare expiry date to current date stamp.

seeds.scene: A construction site entrance with several signs: 'Hard Hat Area', 'Authorized Personnel', 'Warning High Voltage', and a posted regulation list requires also 'Safety Boots Required' but it is not present.
seeds.question: Which legally-required sign is missing?
seeds.lever: Compare visible signage set with regulation requirement list to detect omission.

seeds.scene: A biosafety cabinet workspace with required items: pipette, racks, beaker, ethanol bottle. Among them sits a personal coffee mug.
seeds.question: Which item should NOT be present in this workspace?
seeds.answer: the coffee mug (food/drink not allowed in biosafety cabinet)
seeds.lever: Apply biosafety rule prohibiting food/drink to detect the unauthorized item.

seeds.scene: A tackle box with 8 lures and various accessories. Question targets 'pliers'.
seeds.question: Are there any pliers in the tackle box?
seeds.lever: Confirm absence by inventory; resist over-eagerly identifying lookalikes (lure trebles, hook removers) as pliers.

seeds.scene: A desk with many objects: stapler, books, mug, phone, pens, lamp. Question targets a stapler.
seeds.question: Is there at least one stapler on the desk?
seeds.lever: Confirm presence vs camouflaged identification; report yes/no precisely.

seeds.scene: A wall of 12 ID badges; each shows a unique 4-digit number printed large. Two badges share the same number due to a clerical error.
seeds.question: Are all badge numbers unique?
seeds.answer: no — two badges share the same number
seeds.lever: Detect duplicate among many; existence test on duplicates.

seeds.scene: A corridor with a fire-exit door at the end; a chair has been placed in front of the door blocking egress.
seeds.question: Is the fire exit obstructed?
seeds.answer: yes — a chair blocks the door
seeds.lever: Detect obstruction in safety-critical pathway.

seeds.scene: A furniture-assembly parts laid out: 4 legs, 12 of the planned 14 screws, 2 of the planned 3 hex keys, all panels present.
seeds.question: What parts are MISSING from the box?
seeds.lever: Compare expected vs visible counts per part type; report all missing types.

seeds.scene: A playground with 15 children and 1 visible adult supervisor; posted rule 'minimum 1 adult per 10 children'.
seeds.question: Is the supervision rule satisfied?
seeds.lever: Compute required adults from headcount and rule, compare to visible adults.

seeds.scene: A shoe display floor with many shoes. Most are arranged in left/right pairs of the same model. One single right shoe is shown without its left counterpart visible.
seeds.question: Is there an unpaired shoe?
seeds.answer: yes — one right shoe lacks its left
seeds.lever: Match L/R shoes by model; identify the unpaired item.

seeds.scene: A glass case with many ancient coins; question targets 'a coin from the year 1923 specifically'.
seeds.question: Is there a 1923 coin in the case?
seeds.answer: yes/no based on visible date inscriptions
seeds.lever: Search for a specific year inscription among many similar coins.

seeds.scene: A pantry with many partially-occluded items behind front-row goods. The label of a flour bag peeks out from behind the rice.
seeds.question: Is there flour in the pantry?
seeds.lever: Infer presence from partially-visible label cue.

seeds.scene: A document checklist marked complete: ID, paystubs, bank statements, tax return. The visible packet has ID, paystubs, bank statements; tax return is not present.
seeds.question: Is the packet actually complete vs the checklist?
seeds.lever: Compare checked-off items to visible items; flag missing despite check.

seeds.scene: A photo of a fishbowl tipped on its side with water still completely filling it (no air gap, no spill).
seeds.question: Is the situation physically possible?
seeds.answer: no — water should redistribute by gravity
seeds.lever: Apply physics; flag impossible static state.

seeds.scene: A warehouse floor with 6 workers; PPE rule: hard hat + safety vest + steel-toe boots. Visible: W1 all 3, W2 missing vest, W3 all 3, W4 missing hat, W5 all 3, W6 missing boots.
seeds.question: How many workers are FULLY compliant?
seeds.lever: Apply 3-condition AND check per worker; count those meeting all.

seeds.scene: A queue of 6 people at a service counter; counter requires 'wearing mask AND holding ticket AND has ID'. Visible: P1 mask+ticket no ID, P2 ticket+ID no mask, P3 mask+ID no ticket, P4 mask+ticket+ID, P5 only ticket, P6 only mask.
seeds.question: How many people satisfy ALL three requirements?
seeds.lever: Apply 3-way AND across each person; count exactly those satisfying all.

seeds.scene: A pile of mixed LEGO bricks of many colors. Question targets a single specific element 'a 2x4 lime-green brick'.
seeds.question: Is there a 2x4 lime-green brick in the pile?
seeds.lever: Search for a specific color × shape conjunction in cluttered pile; resist confounders (4x2 lime, 2x3 lime, 2x4 dark green).
